title: StandardPolicyERC1155.sol returns amount == 1 instead of amount == order.amount
code:
function canMatchMakerAsk(Order calldata makerAsk, Order calldata takerBid)
        external
        pure
        override
        returns (
            bool,
            uint256,
            uint256,
            uint256,
            AssetType
        )
    {
        return (
            (makerAsk.side != takerBid.side) &&
            (makerAsk.paymentToken == takerBid.paymentToken) &&
            (makerAsk.collection == takerBid.collection) &&
            (makerAsk.tokenId == takerBid.tokenId) &&
            (makerAsk.matchingPolicy == takerBid.matchingPolicy) &&
            (makerAsk.price == takerBid.price),
            makerAsk.price,
            makerAsk.tokenId,
            1,
            AssetType.ERC1155
        );
    }
